name: investment.rfqs

list.description: Read complete native TARGET_RFQ subtasks within the verified date scope.

parameters.name: from-date
parameters.description: Native inquiry-date lower bound YYYY-MM-DD; pair with to-date.

parameters.name: to-date
parameters.description: Native inquiry-date upper bound YYYY-MM-DD, at or after from-date.

purpose: Inspect native investment inquiry subtasks through one bounded inquiry-only request.

fields.name: inquirySubTaskId
fields.meaning: Native subtask identity; distinct subtasks retain their own records.

fields.name: inquiryTaskId
fields.meaning: Native parent reference, retained without using it to merge subtasks.

fields.name: inquiryStartTime
fields.meaning: Native source value; timezone and date-bound membership are unproven.

fields.name: quotedNum
fields.meaning: Original counter value, including null, blank or negative values; no arithmetic or coercion.

identity_description: Native nonempty inquirySubTaskId identifies one returned TARGET_RFQ subtask within the application and exact inquiry-date scope.
limitations: One JSON POST /rfq/subInquiryTask/querySubInquiryTask.json sends exactly rowStart=0, pageSize=5000, inquiryType=TARGET_RFQ and compact inquiryStartDate/inquiryEndDate. The request has no tenant key; the verified application startup session supplies tenant context.
Both public ISO date bounds are required and ordered. Native timestamp timezone and exact source boundary semantics remain unknown; no local timestamp membership or date conversion is inferred.

Only the qualified TARGET_RFQ source is supported. No type, product, status, parent or subtask filters; no offset fallback, automatic partitioning, source supplementation or related-detail acquisition.

Native data.data records and data.totalCount must fit the single response. The host SDK owns completeness and publication; duplicate/conflicting identities or count gaps remain incomplete, and rejected refresh preserves the previous capture.

Every native field, type, nested object and unknown addition is retained. Nullable, blank, zero, negative and unknown counter/status/time values are preserved without interpretation. Parent references do not collapse subtask identities.

Width 5000 is a historical successful request size, not a measured backend maximum. Current nonempty exact-candidate qualification is required. Query refresh manages temporary cache and does not import runtime data.
